question: What is the basic goal of self-supervised learning?
direct_answer: To learn useful representations from unlabeled data by creating a training target automatically.
expanded_answer: Self-supervised learning turns the data itself into supervision. Instead of needing human labels, the model solves a pretext task such as predicting masked parts, matching augmented views, or recovering a transformed signal. The main objective is not the proxy task itself, but learning embeddings that transfer well to downstream tasks.
key_points: Creates targets automatically from the data
common_wrong_ideas: It is the same as unsupervised learning with no training objective
It only works for text or only for vision
The proxy task is the final goal
